title: Sources: Jensen Huang said Nvidia doesn't need a succession plan because it operates a unique business model and such a plan would create unnecessary hierarchy (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Sources: Jensen Huang said Nvidia doesn't need a succession plan because it operates a unique business model and such a plan would create unnecessary hierarchy — Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Tuesday struck a conciliatory and remorseful tone while leading his first employee meeting since being reinstated …
